local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage.Shared
local Config = require(Shared.Config)
local ItemCatalog = require(Shared.ItemCatalog)
local Log = require(Shared.Log)
local Remotes = require(Shared.Remotes)

local CurrencyService = require(script.Parent.CurrencyService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local ShopService = {}

local lastPurchase: { [Player]: number } = {}

local function isOnCooldown(player: Player): boolean
	local last = lastPurchase[player]
	if last == nil then
		return false
	end
	return os.clock() - last < Config.PurchaseCooldown
end

local function applyEquipped(player: Player)
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid == nil then
		return
	end

	local speed = Config.BaseWalkSpeed
	local data = DataService.get(player)
	if data and data.equipped then
		local item = ItemCatalog.getById(data.equipped)
		if item and item.stats and item.stats.walkSpeedBonus then
			speed += item.stats.walkSpeedBonus
		end
	end
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = speed
end

local function onBuyItem(player: Player, itemId: any)
	if type(itemId) ~= "number" then
		Log.warn("ShopService", "bad item id from", player.Name)
		return
	end

	if isOnCooldown(player) then
		return
	end
	lastPurchase[player] = os.clock()

	local item = ItemCatalog.getById(itemId)
	if item == nil then
		Log.warn("ShopService", player.Name, "tried to buy unknown item", itemId)
		return
	end

	if DataService.hasItem(player, item.id) then
		return
	end

	if not CurrencyService.canAfford(player, item.price) then
		return
	end

	CurrencyService.add(player, -item.price, "shop_purchase")
	DataService.addItem(player, item.id)
	Log.info("ShopService", player.Name, "bought", item.name)
end

local function onEquipItem(player: Player, itemId: any)
	if itemId == nil then
		DataService.setEquipped(player, nil)
		applyEquipped(player)
		return
	end
	if type(itemId) ~= "number" then
		return
	end

	local item = ItemCatalog.getById(itemId)
	if item == nil or not DataService.hasItem(player, item.id) then
		return
	end

	if DataService.setEquipped(player, item.id) then
		applyEquipped(player)
	end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player: Player)
	-- Wait a frame so the Humanoid exists before applying stats.
	task.defer(applyEquipped, player)
end

local function watchPlayer(player: Player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
		onCharacterAdded(player)
	end)
end

function ShopService.init()
	Remotes.get("BuyItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(onBuyItem)
	Remotes.get("EquipItem").OnServerEvent:Connect(onEquipItem)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		lastPurchase[player] = nil
	end)
end

function ShopService.start()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watchPlayer(player)
	end
end

return ShopService

	end
end

local function buildRow(list: ScrollingFrame, item, order: number)
	local row = Instance.new("Frame")
	row.Name = item.name
	row.LayoutOrder = order

	row.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 43, 56)

	local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
	icon.Name = "Icon"
	icon.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48)

		Remotes.get("BuyItem"):FireServer(item.id)

	if type(reason) ~= "string" or reason == "" then

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local UIController = {}

local THEME = {
	panel = Color3.fromRGB(28, 30, 40),
	panelStroke = Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 100),
	button = Color3.fromRGB(70, 130, 220),
	buttonHover = Color3.fromRGB(90, 150, 240),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 245),
	font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
}

local screenGui: ScreenGui? = nil
local panels: { [string]: Frame } = {}

function UIController.getTheme()
	return THEME
end

function UIController.getRoot(): ScreenGui
	if screenGui == nil then
		local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gui.Name = "CoinRushUI"
		gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
		gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		screenGui = gui
	end
	return screenGui :: ScreenGui
end

function UIController.createPanel(name: string, size: UDim2, position: UDim2): Frame
	local existing = panels[name]
	if existing then
		return existing
	end

	local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
	panel.Name = name
	panel.Size = size
	panel.Position = position
	panel.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.panel
	panel.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
	panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
	panel.Visible = false
	panel.Parent = UIController.getRoot()

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
	corner.Parent = panel

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = THEME.panelStroke
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = panel

	panels[name] = panel
	return panel
end

function UIController.getPanel(name: string): Frame?
	return panels[name]
end

function UIController.createLabel(parent: GuiObject, text: string): TextLabel
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24)
	label.Font = THEME.font
	label.TextSize = 18
	label.TextColor3 = THEME.text
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Text = text
	label.Parent = parent
	return label
end

function UIController.createButton(parent: GuiObject, text: string, onClick: () -> ()): TextButton
	local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
	button.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 32)
	button.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.button
	button.AutoButtonColor = false
	button.Font = THEME.font
	button.TextSize = 16
	button.TextColor3 = THEME.text
	button.Text = text
	button.Parent = parent

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = button

	button.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
		if button.Active then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.buttonHover
		end
	end)
	button.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
		if button.Active then
			button.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.button
		end
	end)
	button.Activated:Connect(function()
		if button.Active then
			onClick()
		end
	end)

	return button

		end

		end
	end

	UIController.getRoot()
end

return UIController

The client now disables the Buy button while a purchase is in flight, and the server already rejects purchases during the cooldown. I didn't change the server.

**Server (`ShopService.luau`, `onBuyItem`):** Already correct. `isOnCooldown` returns early when `os.clock() - lastPurchase < Config.PurchaseCooldown` (0.5 s), and the timestamp is stamped before any other check, so rapid repeats are dropped. The ownership check and the coin deduction/item grant also run without yielding, so two requests can't both pass them. I left it alone.

**Client (`ShopController.luau`):**
- Clicking Buy calls a new `requestPurchase(itemId)`, which marks the item as pending, fires `BuyItem`, and redraws the button as disabled with the label "Buying".
- Pending clears when `InventoryChanged` arrives, or after `BUY_TIMEOUT` (1 s). The timeout covers rejected requests, since the server sends no reply in that case.
- Each request gets a token, so a stale 1 s timer from an earlier click can't re-enable a newer pending purchase.

Choices I made that you may want to change:
- Any `InventoryChanged` clears all pending state, not just the one for the item bought. That includes equip-triggered updates, so a purchase still in flight can re-enable early in that case. Matching it to the purchased item would mean the server echoing the item id.
- The pending label is "Buying", and the disabled colors match the "Owned" style.
